name: Kirameki School Life SP - The Wonder Years
original_name: きらめきスクールライフSP
source:
This dating sim comes with the limited edition of "Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai Portable". It represents a certain game that appears in the story of the original "Boku wa Tomodachi ga Sukunai" light novels.

[Edited from [url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2011-10-06/boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-psp-game-to-bundle-dating-sim]ANN[/url]]
translation:
這款戀愛模擬遊戲隨《我的朋友很少PSP》限定版附贈。它重現了輕小說原作《我的朋友很少》裡的一款遊戲。

［改寫自[url=http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/interest/2011-10-06/boku-wa-tomodachi-ga-sukunai-psp-game-to-bundle-dating-sim]ANN[/url]］
